notes: The italicized 'endureth' is read as the construction-supplied linking verb on the prepositional predicate (rules 20 and 49) rather than as an added lexical verb: rule 20's subtraction finds that dropping it leaves the predication the Hebrew already made ('thy lovingkindness ... for ever') intact and introduces no participant the Hebrew never wrote. The unit heads on the preposition 'for' under rule 49. Both readings are recorded in the unit's note; the italic corroborates the supply and decides nothing (rule 7).

The recast 'that which concerneth' is placed whole on בַּעַד under rule 24, headed on the content word the phrase turns on; the suffix keeps only 'me', so rule 18's relative-pronoun sentence is not available and is named as the competing reading.
'thine own' is the suffix's whole emphatic possessive under rule 18; 'own' is not attached to the host noun standing beside it.
The prohibitive אַל takes 'not' and the jussive takes 'Forsake', the two discontinuous in the English under rule 25.
